name: – Sabrina Repp – After § 36 – Am 10
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 36a. Calls on the Member States to introduce a ‘guarantee of independence’ for young people aged between 18 and 25, including students, trainees, apprentices and young people seeking employment, in order to combat poverty and social exclusion and to facilitate their transition to independent living, by ensuring they have access to adequate financial support throughout the year, affordable housing, education and training, healthcare and appropriate social support services.
